SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA, COUNTY OF VENTURA
MARIA SANCHEZ v. PACIFIC COAST FRESH, INC. Case No. 26CV07731
DEFENDANT'S ANSWER TO PLAINTIFF'S CLASS AND REPRESENTATIVE ACTION COMPLAINT
Defendant Pacific Coast Fresh, Inc. answers the Complaint as follows. Under Code of Civil Procedure section 431.30(d), Defendant generally denies each and every allegation of the unverified Complaint.
AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSES
FIRST AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSE (Statute of Limitations) The claims are barred in part by Code of Civil Procedure sections 338 and 340.
SECOND AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSE (Lack of Standing) Plaintiff lacks standing to pursue civil penalties for violations she did not personally suffer.
THIRD AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSE (Good Faith Dispute) Any failure to pay wages at separation resulted from a good faith dispute.
